guidance.evidence_criterion: Read the operative definition, duty or permission together with its trigger, conditions, exceptions and survival language. Compare the exact actor, action, object, quantifier and polarity; a nearby restriction or broad silence is not permission. Return NotMentioned when neither the statement nor its contractual opposite is settled. For return/destruction, distinguish an unconditional termination-triggered duty from a duty arising only on request; separately inspect any express retained-copy or infeasibility exception. A comprehensive all-copies return/destruction command supports opposition to post-return retention, but does not itself authorize copying. For copying, require an affirmative copying right for Entailment; a prohibition, consent requirement or exception located only in another agreement supports opposition, while a retained archival copy or required oral summary is not a general copying permission. For independent development and third-party acquisition, require the corresponding express exclusion or permission; do not infer either from purpose limits, public-information clauses, general nondisclosure terms or absence of a prohibition. operations.rationale: The empty parent provides no guidance despite repeated relation and evidence failures. The new procedure repairs observed over-inference from silence, purpose clauses, retention provisions and generic exclusions; separates termination from request triggers; distinguishes standing third-party permission from approval-only or employee-only restrictions; and requires complete operative evidence chains. These boundaries are supported by contrasting outcomes across all supplied sources.
